Author: Rajiv Joshi

HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT ALLAHABAD ?Court No. - 72 Case :- APPLICATION U/S 482 No. - 37484 of 2019 Applicant :- Rajnath Gupta Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And Anr Counsel for Applicant :- Awadhesh Kumar Malviya
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajiv Joshi,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State.
The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed for quashing the non-bailable warrant dated 25.06.2019 and summoning order dated 06.04.2017 in Criminal Case No. 728 of 2017 (State Vs.
Rajnath Gupta), under Section- 26/63 Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006, Police Station- Nandganj, District- Ghazipur, pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate Saidpur,

opennyai_summary.decision:
Learned counsel for the applicant has made a statement at bar that his client shall appear within one month from today along with proper application, thus, the proceedings of the case may be stayed.
Prayer for quashing non-bailable warrant and summoning order issued against the applicants is refused.
However, considering the facts and circumstances, it is provided that if the applicant appears before the court concerned within one month from today with an application for recall of the non-bailable warrant, the concerned Magistrate shall decide the same in accordance with law.
For the period of one month from today, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant.
In case, the applicant fails to appear before the court concerned within one month from today, coercive action shall be taken against him for ensuring his presence in accordance with law.
With the above directions, this application is disposed of finally.
